package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func planningEventFixture() PlanningStateChangedEvent {
	e := PlanningStateChangedEvent{EventType: SubjectPlanningStateChanged, SchemaVersion: 1, StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 10, 5, 1, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Data: PlanningStateChangedData{LearningPathID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", PathVersion: 1, TriggerKind: "OBJECTIVE_EVIDENCE", TriggerIdentity: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Targets: []HybridTargetRef{{Type: TargetConcept, Key: "go.values", Version: "1"}}}}
	e.CorrelationID = e.Data.LearningPathID
	e.CausationID = e.Data.TriggerIdentity
	e.EventID = PlanningStateChangedEventID(e.StudentID, e.Data.LearningPathID, e.Data.TriggerKind, e.Data.TriggerIdentity)
	return e
}

func TestPlanningEventRejectsNestedAmbiguityAndInvalidBounds(t *testing.T) {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(planningEventFixture())
	for name, body := range map[string][]byte{
		"target_duplicate_key": []byte(strings.Replace(string(raw), `"key":"go.values"`, `"key":"go.values","key":"go.values"`, 1)),
		"target_private_field": []byte(strings.Replace(string(raw), `"key":"go.values"`, `"key":"go.values","solution":"secret"`, 1)),
		"null_version":         []byte(strings.Replace(string(raw), `"version":"1"`, `"version":null`, 1)),
		"null_targets":         []byte(strings.Replace(string(raw), `[{"type":"concept","key":"go.values","version":"1"}]`, `null`, 1)),
		"oversized":            append(raw, []byte(strings.Repeat(" ", MaximumPlanningStateEventBytes))...),
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := DecodePlanningStateChangedEvent(body); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid body accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	for _, kind := range []string{"student", "path", "trigger"} {
		e := planningEventFixture()
		switch kind {
		case "student":
			e.StudentID = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
		case "path":
			e.Data.LearningPathID = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
		case "trigger":
			e.Data.TriggerIdentity = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
		}
		e.CorrelationID = e.Data.LearningPathID
		e.CausationID = e.Data.TriggerIdentity
		e.EventID = PlanningStateChangedEventID(e.StudentID, e.Data.LearningPathID, e.Data.TriggerKind, e.Data.TriggerIdentity)
		if ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(e) == nil {
			t.Fatalf("nil %s UUID accepted", kind)
		}
	}
}
func TestPlanningEventStrictIdentityOnlyContract(t *testing.T) {
	e := planningEventFixture()
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(e)
	if _, err := DecodePlanningStateChangedEvent(raw); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for name, body := range map[string][]byte{"duplicate": append([]byte(`{"event_id":"x",`), raw[1:]...), "extra": append([]byte(`{"score":1,`), raw[1:]...), "null": []byte(`null`), "trailing": append(raw, []byte(` {}`)...)} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := DecodePlanningStateChangedEvent(body); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("accepted invalid event")
			}
		})
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*PlanningStateChangedEvent){"kind": func(e *PlanningStateChangedEvent) { e.Data.TriggerKind = "TELEMETRY" }, "id": func(e *PlanningStateChangedEvent) { e.EventID = e.StudentID }, "target": func(e *PlanningStateChangedEvent) { e.Data.Targets = append(e.Data.Targets, e.Data.Targets[0]) }, "path": func(e *PlanningStateChangedEvent) { e.Data.PathVersion = 0 }} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			bad := planningEventFixture()
			mutate(&bad)
			if ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(bad) == nil {
				t.Fatal("accepted invalid event")
			}
		})
	}
}
